protocols.title: Teduglutide (5 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Individual-page statements from a secondary source; not independently verified medical guidance. Approved-label schedule reported by page: 0.05 mg/kg SC once daily, ongoing, for short bowel syndrome with parenteral-support dependence; renal impairment (eGFR <60) uses 0.025 mg/kg. Commercial 5 mg vial reconstituted with exactly 0.5 mL sterile water to 10 mg/mL; only 3.8 mg (0.38 mL) withdrawable. Prescription product under specialist supervision, not a research-vial recommendation.

schedule.description: Prescription product for short bowel syndrome with parenteral-support dependence. Source reports half-dose 0.025 mg/kg for eGFR <60; product label uses matched diluent, not research-vial mixing.

regimen.notes: FDA-approved product schedule applies only to eligible patients under specialist supervision; research-grade 5 mg vial is not the approved presentation.
